summary.en: Russia launched a large-scale airstrike on Ukraine on Friday, with authorities in Kyiv saying at least seven people were killed in the capital. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described it as one of the largest airstrikes in nearly five years of war. Ukrainian officials said Russia fired more than 80 missiles and 400 drones, knocking out power in many areas, and three bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv were hit and damaged. Neighbouring Poland said two Russian missiles and a drone were suspected to have fallen in its south-east, and Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Russia was deliberately provoking and that NATO had been notified immediately.
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯星期五对乌克兰发动大规模空袭，基辅当局指首都最少七人死亡。乌克兰总统泽连斯基形容，今次是近五年战事以来最大规模空袭之一。乌方指俄军发射超过80枚导弹及400架无人机，全国多地电力中断，基辅三条横跨第聂伯河的大桥被击中受损。邻国波兰表示，怀疑有两枚俄军导弹及一架无人机落入东南部境内，总理图斯克批评俄方蓄意挑衅，已即时通报北约。
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯星期五對烏克蘭發動大規模空襲，基輔當局指首都最少七人死亡。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基形容，今次是近五年戰事以來最大規模空襲之一。烏方指俄軍發射超過80枚導彈及400架無人機，全國多地電力中斷，基輔三條橫跨第聶伯河的大橋被擊中受損。鄰國波蘭表示，懷疑有兩枚俄軍導彈及一架無人機落入東南部境內，總理圖斯克批評俄方蓄意挑釁，已即時通報北約。

summary.en: France has raised the animal epidemic risk level for highly pathogenic avian influenza to the highest tier from Friday, in response to outbreaks among wild birds across Europe. The French government said cases have risen in wild birds in several neighbouring countries and the virus could spread along migratory bird routes; confirmed cases have already appeared in French wildlife and in small household poultry farms. Data shows six outbreaks have been reported in France since August, three at commercial farms and three involving household farms or captive birds.

summary.en: The UK and the EU held a summit in Brussels, reaching agreements on food trade, youth mobility and carbon emissions. The two sides completed negotiations on a sanitary and phytosanitary agreement, planned for implementation in March 2028 to cut checks and certification on agri-food trade, and finalised a deal linking their carbon emissions trading systems from 2028. On youth exchanges, they agreed a Youth Experience Scheme allowing 100,000 young people from each side to live in the other's territory for up to three years to work, study, volunteer or travel, aiming to launch by 2028 and open to participants by January 2030.
summary.zh_hans: 英国与欧盟在比利时布鲁塞尔举行峰会，就食品贸易、青年流动及碳排放等领域达成协议。双方完成动植物卫生检疫协定谈判，计划2028年3月实施，减少农产品贸易的检查与认证要求；碳排放交易体系对接协定亦已完成谈判，计划2028年起实施。青年交流方面，双方同意设立青年体验计划，欧盟与英国各10万名青年可在对方境内居留最长三年，工作、学习、义工或旅行皆可，目标最迟2028年启动，2030年1月前开放参与。
summary.zh_hant: 英國與歐盟在比利時布魯塞爾舉行峰會，就食品貿易、青年流動及碳排放等領域達成協議。雙方完成動植物衛生檢疫協定談判，計劃2028年3月實施，減少農產品貿易的檢查與認證要求；碳排放交易體系對接協定亦已完成談判，計劃2028年起實施。青年交流方面，雙方同意設立青年體驗計劃，歐盟與英國各10萬名青年可在對方境內居留最長三年，工作、學習、義工或旅行皆可，目標最遲2028年啟動，2030年1月前開放參與。

summary.en: The University of Michigan's final US consumer sentiment index for November rose to 51.5, above the preliminary reading of 51 and in line with market expectations; October's final reading was 48. The current conditions index came in at 49.4, below the preliminary 51 and the expected 51.6, but above October's 46.7. One-year inflation expectations eased to 3.7% from a preliminary 4.3% and October's 4.7%, while five-year expectations stood at 3.3%.

summary.en: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government has strongly condemned the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission for publishing its 2026 report, which it said smears Hong Kong with false and biased claims. A spokesman said the government strongly disapproves of and firmly opposes the commission for putting politics above the rule of law and repeatedly interfering in Hong Kong affairs through its reports, and urged the United States to face the facts and immediately stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs, which are purely China's internal affairs. The government also said some external forces spread fake news after the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po to smear rescue work, and it will not tolerate malicious smearing or incitement of hatred. The spokesman added that Jimmy Lai-linked activist Joshua Wong, mentioned in the report, pleaded guilty to conspiracy to collude with foreign forces to endanger national security and was jailed for 10 years.

summary.en: Premier Li Qiang met Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing for the 11th China-Australia Prime Ministers' Annual Meeting. Li said China-Australia relations are maintaining positive momentum with increasingly close exchanges at all levels, and with 2027 marking the 55th anniversary of diplomatic ties, China is willing to use the occasion to properly manage differences and advance the comprehensive strategic partnership. Li added China is willing to expand bilateral trade, further liberalise and facilitate trade and investment, and jointly safeguard the multilateral system and free trade. Albanese said Australia and China should not let differences interfere with bilateral relations and are willing to jointly uphold the rules-based multilateral trading system.

summary.zh_hant: 國務院總理李強在北京釣魚台國賓館與澳洲總理阿爾巴內塞舉行第十一輪中澳總理年度會晤。李強表示，當前中澳關係保持積極發展勢頭，各層級交往日益密切，明年是中澳建交55周年，中方願同澳方以此為契機，妥善管控分歧，推動全面戰略伙伴關係取得更多積極成效。李強說，中方願同澳方推動雙邊貿易擴大規模，進一步提升貿易投資自由化便利化水平，共同維護多邊體系和自由貿易。阿爾巴內塞表示，澳中不應讓分歧干擾雙邊關係，願攜手維護以規則為基礎的多邊貿易體制。

summary.en: The Equal Opportunities Commission held a reception to mark its 30th anniversary, at which Chief Executive John Lee said in a video address that the government's first Five-Year Plan sets out to build an equal and caring society and a diverse, inclusive community, with more than HK$100 million allocated to the EOC in 2026-27 to support its public education and publicity work promoting mutual respect, diversity and inclusion. Lee said this year's Policy Address introduced measures across the board, including making the after-school care programme permanent, progressively providing free pre-pregnancy and postnatal information services, expanding Chinese-language support for non-Chinese-speaking students, and adding rehabilitation service places for persons with disabilities.
summary.zh_hans: 平等机会委员会举行30周年志庆酒会，行政长官李家超视像致辞表示，特区政府刚公布《香港第一个五年规划》，明确提出共建平等关爱社会，积极构建多元共融社区，并在2026至27年度向平机会拨款超过一亿元，支持平机会多元化的公众宣传教育等工作，推广相互尊重、多元包容的价值观。李家超说，今年《施政报告》多管齐下为各阶层排忧解难，包括将「在校课后托管服务计划」恒常化、逐步提供免费孕前及产后资讯服务、扩大非华语学童中文支援，以及增加残疾人士康复服务名额。
summary.zh_hant: 平等機會委員會舉行30周年誌慶酒會，行政長官李家超視像致辭表示，特區政府剛公布《香港第一個五年規劃》，明確提出共建平等關愛社會，積極構建多元共融社區，並在2026至27年度向平機會撥款超過一億元，支持平機會多元化的公眾宣傳教育等工作，推廣相互尊重、多元包容的價值觀。李家超說，今年《施政報告》多管齊下為各階層排憂解難，包括將「在校課後託管服務計劃」恆常化、逐步提供免費孕前及產後資訊服務、擴大非華語學童中文支援，以及增加殘疾人士康復服務名額。

summary.en: Polish Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz said Russia violated Polish airspace overnight, with three objects entering Poland possibly being two missiles and a drone, condemning Moscow's provocation. The "Coalition of the Willing" of Ukraine's allies is preparing a military exercise in Poland on Friday local time, with defence chiefs from France, Britain and the Baltic states attending; Kosiniak-Kamysz said the timing was no coincidence, the exercise will proceed as planned, and Poland will ask NATO for more support to strengthen the alliance's eastern flank. Prime Minister Donald Tusk said the incident clearly shows why Poland must take part in Ukraine peace talks.

summary.en: Police have warned on their CyberDefender social media account that scammers are impersonating staff of institutions, accurately reciting shoppers' names, purchase records and delivery addresses, claiming an ordered item is out of stock and then using a refund as bait to lure victims into clicking links, entering personal details or transferring money. Police said the shoppers' data was "likely" obtained from data breaches at some institutions, and breached data may only be exploited after a delay. Police advised the public to watch for official breach notices, hang up and verify through official channels, use separate strong passwords and switch on two-factor authentication; anyone in doubt can call the Anti-Scam Helpline on 18222.
summary.zh_hans: 警方在「守网者」社交平台发帖提醒，近日有骗徒冒充机构职员，能准确讲出购物者的姓名、购买纪录和送货地址，声称订购的物品「无货」，再以退款作诱饵，诱骗事主按连结、输入个人资料甚至转账。警方指出，骗徒取得的购物资料「好可能」源自部分机构的资料外泄事件，外泄资料可能隔一段时间才被利用。警方提醒市民留意官方公告、收线再核实、使用独立密码及开启双重认证；如有怀疑，可致电防骗易热线18222查询。
summary.zh_hant: 警方在「守網者」社交平台發帖提醒，近日有騙徒冒充機構職員，能準確講出購物者的姓名、購買紀錄和送貨地址，聲稱訂購的物品「無貨」，再以退款作誘餌，誘騙事主按連結、輸入個人資料甚至轉賬。警方指出，騙徒取得的購物資料「好可能」源自部分機構的資料外洩事件，外洩資料可能隔一段時間才被利用。警方提醒市民留意官方公告、收線再核實、使用獨立密碼及開啟雙重認證；如有懷疑，可致電防騙易熱線18222查詢。

summary.en: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung visited the Gallant Garden to pay tribute to the late fire station officer Ho Wai-ho, and visited Sha Tin Fire Station, where he had been stationed, to see his fellow firefighters. Yeung said on social media that the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po was heartbreaking: many lost loved ones and friends, and the city lost a brave and selfless firefighter, while more than 10 firefighters were injured on the front line. She said the government always remembers the pain the fire brought to victims and society and stands with them, and that the fire revealed the importance and necessity of reform — lessons will be learned and reforms fully implemented to prevent a repeat tragedy.

summary.en: Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited has warned the public about a fraudulent website, fpshk.xyz, that purports to be from the company and imitates its "Buyer Online Protection" service, offering refunds, unauthorised-transaction reporting and online transaction support for Faster Payment System payments, and directing users to a fraudster impersonating customer service staff. The company stressed the fake website has no affiliation with it or its business, and it does not provide FPS services directly to the public or contact members of the public proactively. Anyone receiving suspicious communications purporting to be from the company should call its general line on 2533 1111 to verify, and suspected victims should report to the police promptly.
summary.zh_hans: 香港银行同业结算有限公司发出警示，指近日发现一个假冒该公司的网站fpshk.xyz，假扮提供「买家网上保障」服务，包括退款、未经授权交易举报及转数快网上交易支援，并引导用户联络冒充客服的骗徒。结算公司强调，假网站与该公司及其业务完全无关，该公司不会直接向市民提供转数快服务，也不会主动联络市民。市民如收到可疑讯息，应致电2533 1111核实，怀疑受骗应立即报警。
summary.zh_hant: 香港銀行同業結算有限公司發出警示，指近日發現一個假冒該公司的網站fpshk.xyz，假扮提供「買家網上保障」服務，包括退款、未經授權交易舉報及轉數快網上交易支援，並引導用戶聯絡冒充客服的騙徒。結算公司強調，假網站與該公司及其業務完全無關，該公司不會直接向市民提供轉數快服務，也不會主動向市民聯絡。市民如收到可疑訊息，應致電2533 1111核實，懷疑受騙應立即報警。

title.en: HKICL warns of fake website impersonating its FPS payment service

summary.en: Former French prime minister Dominique de Villepin has announced he will run in France's 2027 presidential election. De Villepin, who served as foreign minister, rose to prominence in 2003 when he spoke for the French government against the US invasion of Iraq. He has drawn renewed attention in recent years for his positions on international affairs, notably on the war in Gaza.
summary.zh_hans: 法国前总理德维尔潘宣布，将参加2027年法国总统选举。德维尔潘曾任法国外长，2003年代表法国政府公开反对美国发动伊拉克战争，一举成名。近年他就加沙战争等国际议题多次表态，重新受到公众关注。
summary.zh_hant: 法國前總理德維爾潘宣布，將參加2027年法國總統選舉。德維爾潘曾任法國外長，2003年代表法國政府公開反對美國發動伊拉克戰爭，一舉成名。近年他就加沙戰爭等國際議題多次表態，重新受到公眾關注。

title.en: De Villepin announces 2027 French presidential bid, the ex-PM who opposed the Iraq War eyes the Elysee
